notes.sowing: Start seeds indoors 8 to 10 weeks before your last frost, {cm:0.6} deep, at {c:27} to {c:32} on a heat mat. Harden off and plant out 2 to 4 weeks after your last frost, once nights stay above {c:10} and the soil has warmed.
notes.care: Water evenly and mulch once the soil is warm. Flowers drop in hot spells above {c:32} and when nights fall below {c:16}. Stake plants that are heavy with fruit, since the branches snap easily.
notes.harvest: Pick green peppers once full sized and firm, or leave them 2 to 3 weeks longer to color and sweeten. Cut the stem with shears rather than pulling.
